title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Elon Musk Backs Dario Amodei's Call to Slow AI Development: Elon Musk publicly supported Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's essay urging an industry-wide slowdown on frontier model development as recursive self-improvement begins, while sharing that Grok 4.7 is delayed a few days due to RL length-penalty issues.

OpenAI Fixes GPT-6 Astra Engine Degraded Performance & Issues Reset: OpenAI staff fixed misconfigured skill triggers and context management experiments that caused early stops for 4,000+ users, while announcing the deprecation of legacy GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark models.

Cognition Launches Devin Fusion Multi-Model Coding Harness: Cognition released Devin Fusion in Devin CLI, pairing frontier models like Fable 5.1 or Astra for planning with SWE-2 for execution, cutting coding benchmark costs by up to 43%.

ChatGPT Sites Exceeds 5 Million Apps with New Workspace Tools: OpenAI announced over 5 million web applications built on ChatGPT Sites, introducing shared workspace co-editing, private access links, custom domains, and database inspection.

6TB Leak from Chinese LLM Routers Exposes Enterprise SSH Keys: Security researcher Chaofan Shou revealed a 6TB leak from commercial Chinese LLM API routers exposing active SSH keys, cloud tokens, and internal prompt logs across top tech companies and government bodies.

items.title: @elonmusk & @DarioAmodei: Elon Musk Backs Anthropic CEO's Call to Slow Down AI Development
items.body: Elon Musk publicly endorsed Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's essay 'We Must Pace the Frontier', which advocates for industry-wide safety evaluators and a controlled development pace as recursive self-improvement emerges across frontier labs.

items.title: @elonmusk: Grok 4.7 Delayed A Few Days for Reinforcement Learning Adjustments
items.body: Elon Musk explained Grok 4.7 requires additional fine-tuning after RL training overly penalized response length, causing the model to give up prematurely on complex reasoning tasks.

items.title: @thsottiaux & @ChrisGPT: OpenAI Resolves GPT-6 Astra Engine Degradation & Issues Reset
items.body: OpenAI engineer Tibo Sottiaux confirmed fixes for GPT-6 Astra quality issues caused by legacy skill conflicts and an opt-in context experiment, rolling out an automatic usage reset for impacted users.

items.title: @cognition & @ArtificialAnlys: Cognition Unveils Devin Fusion Multi-Model Agent Harness
items.body: Cognition launched Devin Fusion in Devin CLI, enabling developers to pair frontier planning models (Fable 5.1 / GPT-6 Astra) with cost-effective execution sidekicks (SWE-2), reducing benchmark token costs by up to 43%.

items.title: @ChatGPT: ChatGPT Sites Surpasses 5M Apps with Team Collaboration Tools
items.body: OpenAI reported over 5 million web apps created on ChatGPT Sites, releasing team co-editing, private link sharing, custom domain mapping, and live database inspection capabilities.

items.title: @shoucccc: 6TB Chinese LLM Router Leak Exposes Enterprise SSH & Cloud Credentials
items.body: Security researcher Chaofan Shou disclosed a 6TB leak from commercial Chinese LLM API routers containing active SSH keys, cloud tokens, and internal prompt logs from major tech firms and government entities.

items.body: OpenAI Developers published a guide on structuring AGENTS.md and skill triggers to eliminate redundant context loading and lower token burn when executing agentic tasks with GPT-6 Astra.
